entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Claw Attack
entries.description: The sphinx makes one claw attack.

entries.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

entries.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.description: The sphinx casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.

entries.name: Reckless
entries.description: At the start of its turn, the giant can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Siege Monster
entries.description: The giant deals double damage to objects and structures.

entries.name: Stone Camouflage
entries.description: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The giant makes two slam attacks. The first of those attacks that hits deals an extra 18 (4d8) damage if the giant has taken damage since its last turn.

entries.name: Slam
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Rock
entries.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

info.text:
Gruul sunder shamans are angry giants that channel their rage into brutal attacks that deal overwhelming damage to foes and structures alike.

These shamans sometimes lead hill giants and stone giants that also live among the Gruul Clans. They are occasionally joined by cyclopes, ettins, fomorians, and ogres. Like the rest of the Gruul, they hate the urban development that encroaches on the wilds where they once lived-not least because they have so much difficulty fitting inside the small structures. They delight in destroying such edifices, and in the heat of their rage, they walk through buildings, trample people underfoot, and generally cause as much chaos as possible. They often armor themselves with pieces of buildings and wield columns or other architectural elements as clubs.

Giants.

Giants use their tremendous size and strength to advance the cause of no less than four guilds. In the Boros Legion and the Orzhov Syndicate, they are cunning soldiers. The giants of the Cult of Rakdos and the Gruul Clans are no less effective but lack discipline.

entries.name: Cunning Action
entries.description: On each of its turns, the thought spy can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
entries.description:
The thought spy's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 13). The thought spy can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

Spellcasting ability: INT.

At will: charm person, disguise self, encode thoughts [GGR] (see chapter 2)

1/day each: blur, detect thoughts, gaseous form

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The thought spy makes two melee attacks, or it makes three ranged attacks with its daggers.

entries.name: Dagger
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Rapier
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

info.text: Thought spies form the backbone of House Dimir's covert operations. They are trained in stealth and infiltration, tactics that they supplement with rigorously developed mental abilities. To ensure that no secrets slip through Dimir's fingers, they infiltrate rival guilds. In addition to traditional means of gathering intelligence, thought spies use their magic to spy on the thoughts of their targets.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: If Trostani fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Trostani has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Magic Weapons
entries.description: Trostani's weapon attacks are magical.

entries.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries.description: Trostani can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

entries.name: Tree Stride
entries.description: Once on her turn, Trostani can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Trostani's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 24). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

Spellcasting ability: WIS.

At will: dispel magic, druidcraft

3/day each: bless, conjure animals, giant insect, moonbeam, plant growth, spike growth, suggestion

1/day each: conjure fey, mass cure wounds

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Trostani takes three actions: she uses Constrict and Touch of Order, and she casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action.

entries.name: Constrict
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. Trostani can grapple no more than three targets at a time.

entries.name: Touch of Order
entries.description: Melee Spell Attack: +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 10) radiant damage, and Trostani can choose one magic item she can see in the target's possession. Unless it's an artifact, the item's magic is suppressed until the start of Trostani's next turn.

entries.name: Wrath of Mat'Selesnya Recharge 5–6
entries.description: Trostani conjures a momentary whirl of branches and vines at a point she can see within 60 feet of her. Each creature in a 30-foot cube on that point must make a 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and 21 (6d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Voice of Harmony
entries.description: Trostani makes one melee attack, with advantage on the attack roll.

entries.name: Voice of Life
entries.description: Trostani bestows 20 temporary hit points on another creature she can see within 120 feet of her.

entries.name: Voice of Order
entries.description: Trostani casts dispel magic.

entries.name: Chorus of the Conclave (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Trostani casts suggestion. This counts as one of her daily uses of the spell.

entries.name: Awaken Grove Guardians (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.description: Trostani animates one or two trees she can see within 120 feet of her, causing them to uproot themselves and become awakened trees (see the Monster Manual for their stat blocks) for 1 minute or until Trostani uses a bonus action to end the effect. These trees understand Druidic and obey Trostani's spoken commands, but can't speak. If she issues no commands to them, the trees do nothing but follow her and take the Dodge action.

info.text:
The Selesnya guildmaster is an amalgamation of three dryads in body, will, and soul. Each dryad's body extends from a central trunk, so while they possess independent minds, they share a single name-Trostani and a single life force. Usually Trostani communicates the will of the Worldsoul with one voice, but she retains three distinct personalities that embody the three parts of the Selesnyan ideal: order, life, and harmony. In the midst of increasing tensions on Ravnica, the three personalities have recently been at odds over how best to navigate the conclave through such difficult times.

Trostani spends most of her time in the towering tree of Vitu-Ghazi, the Selesnya guildhall. There she communes with Mat'Selesnya and with the dryads who lead individual Selesnya communities across Ravnica.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: The medusa has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Surprise Attack
entries.description: During the first round of combat, the medusa has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that is surprised, and it deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage each time it hits such a creature with an attack.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
The medusa's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 14). The medusa can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

Spellcasting ability: INT.

1/day each: expeditious retreat, fog cloud, misty step

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The medusa makes two claw attacks. It can also use Petrifying Gaze before or after making these attacks.

entries.name: Claw
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries.description: The medusa fixes its gaze on one creature within 60 feet of it that it can see and that can see its eyes. The target must make a 14 Constitution saving throw. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by a greater restoration spell or similar magic.

info.text:
The medusas of Ravnica, often called gorgons, are a monstrous race of creatures that appear superficially similar to human women. In place of hair, a gorgon has a writhing mass of black, serpentine cables, and its hands are scaly claws.

The gaze of a medusa's glowing eyes causes living tissue to petrify. The transformation is rapid, leaving the victim as a stone statue, usually frozen in a position of abject fear or agony-a fine trophy for the medusa's macabre collection. The medusa must exert its will to effect this transformation, so the gaze of a surprised or friendly Ravnican medusa is harmless.

This deadly gaze attack gives medusas a degree of power among the Golgari that is out of proportion with their small numbers. Medusas command a significant share of the guild's smaller cells around Ravnica, and at least one medusa is thought to be angling for control of the entire guild at the moment.

Not all gorgons are so ambitious; some prefer to simply stalk the endless shadows of the undercity like hungry predators.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Rock
entries.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Self-Sacrifice
entries.description: When a creature within 5 feet of the thrull is hit by an attack, the thrull swaps places with that creature and is hit instead.

info.text:
Winged thrulls are at once the most intelligent of Orzhov thrulls (which isn't saying much), as well as the smallest, most unobtrusive, and most mobile. They act as messengers and spies for their Orzhov masters and tend to mimic the mannerisms and movements of the oligarchs they serve.

Thrulls.

When the Orzhov Syndicate rips a soul from its body to create a spirit, the cast-off remains go to the fleshmages, who use their necromantic magic to liquefy the corpse and transform it into something useful. These creations become thrulls, obedient slaves that serve in a variety of menial roles: laborers, messengers, beasts of burden, and even fashion accessories for the elite. Whatever tasks they perform, they wear faceplates forged from devalued coinage to conceal their ghastly features.

Construct Nature.

A thrull doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.name: Siege Monster
entries.description: The wurm deals double damage to objects and structures.

entries.name: Earth Tremors
entries.description: The wurm creates earth tremors as it moves overland or underground. Any creature that comes within 30 feet of the moving wurm for the first time on a turn must succeed on a 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and fall prone. Any structure or object anchored to the ground that comes within 30 feet of the moving wurm for the first time on a turn takes 10 (3d6) force damage.

entries.name: Tunneler
entries.description: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (5d6 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 20 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the wurm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the wurm, and takes 17 (5d6) acid damage at the start of each of the wurm's turns. If the wurm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the wurm must succeed on a 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the wurm. If the wurm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

info.text: Wurms are huge creatures that resemble limbless, wingless dragons. They burrow through the earth and eat virtually anything they come across, and their movement accounts for much of the destruction in the rubblebelt regions of Ravnica. A wurm burrows through loose earth by using deep sonic vibrations to liquefy the earth in front of it and swim through the area. The soil resolidifies and closes behind it. Moving through rock is slower and more difficult, and the wurm leaves a tunnel in its wake. The Gruul Clans appreciate the devastation wurms can create, and the clans sometimes lure them into civilized areas where the destruction can be vast.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Zegana can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: If Zegana fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Zegana has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Zegana is a 15th-level Simic spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following wizard spells prepared:

Spellcasting ability: INT.

Cantrips (at will): acid splash, druidcraft, ray of frost, shape water [XGE]

Level 1 (4 slots): color spray, expeditious retreat, fog cloud, shield

Level 2 (3 slots): enlarge/reduce, gust of wind

Level 3 (3 slots): counterspell, fly, slow

Level 4 (3 slots): control water, ice storm, polymorph

Level 5 (2 slots): conjure elemental, creation

Level 6 (1 slots): move earth, wall of ice

Level 7 (1 slots): prismatic spray, teleport

Level 8 (1 slots): control weather, dominate monster

entries.name: Prime Speaker's Trident
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the trident emits a thunderous boom. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from the prongs of the trident must make a 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 9 (2d8) thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from Zegana. If the creature is underwater, the damage is increased to 13 (3d8). On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

entries.name: Deluge Recharge 4–6
entries.description: Zegana conjures a wave of water that crashes down on an area within 120 feet of her. The area can be up to 30 feet long, up to 10 feet wide, and up to 10 feet tall. Each creature in that area must make a 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone. The water spreads out across the ground, extinguishing unprotected flames it comes in contact with, and then vanishes.

entries.name: Adaptive Skin
entries.description: Zegana gains resistance to one damage type of her choice-acid, fire, lightning, or thunder-until the start of her next turn.

entries.name: Trident
entries.description: Zegana makes one melee attack with the Prime Speaker's Trident.

entries.name: Enlarge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Zegana casts enlarge/reduce on herself, using the enlarge option, without expending a spell slot.

entries.name: Deluge (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.description: Zegana uses Deluge, if available.

info.text: The regal and reticent Prime Speaker Zegana is the merfolk guildmaster of the Simic Combine. She upholds the traditional ways of the guild and its utopian philosophy, which espouses a vision of an ideal world in which nature and civilization coexist in perfect balance. Some people in the guild-members of the Adaptationist faction in particular-argue that her ways are outdated and the guild requires more practical leadership. In response, Zegana maintains that she serves as prime speaker only at the sufferance of the Speakers' Chamber, and if the other speakers wish to replace her, they are certainly within their rights to do so.

entries.name: Two Heads
entries.description: The amphisbaena has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The amphisbaena makes two bite attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 3 (1d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

info.text: Found in Danger at Dunwater, these strange reptiles have a head at either end of their serpentine bodies, each one equipped with venomous fangs. To move, an amphisbaena uses one head to grip the neck of its other head, forming a hoop that rolls over the ground.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Bess can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Claw
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape 11). Bess has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: The croaker can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
entries.description: The croaker can communicate simple concepts to frogs and toads when it speaks in Bullywug.

entries.name: Standing Leap
entries.description: The croaker's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

entries.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries.description: The croaker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Glaaar-pat (3/Day)
entries.description: The croaker sings a song of marshy doom. Each chosen creature within 30 feet of the croaker that can hear the song must make a 12 Wisdom saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this saving throw also has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Rooooo-glog (1/Day)
entries.description: The croaker sings an ode to an elder froghemoth. Each bullywug within 30 feet of the croaker that can hear the song gains 10 temporary hit points.

info.text: Some bullywugs are born with the ability to weave magic into their songs. These rare specimens are raised in protected enclaves where they are taught to use their magic to both heal and harm. As demonstrated in Danger at Dunwater, they are among the most pompous of bullywugs.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: The royal can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Brute
entries.description: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the royal hits with it (included in the attack).

entries.name: Frog Rider
entries.description: The royal has advantage on melee attacks made while riding a frog mount.

entries.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
entries.description: The royal can communicate simple concepts to frogs and toads when it speaks in Bullywug.

entries.name: Standing Leap
entries.description: The royal's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

entries.name: Swamp Camouflage
entries.description: The royal has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The royal makes two attacks: one with its royal spear and one with its bite.

entries.name: Royal Spear
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Croaked Decree (1/Day)
entries.description: The royal makes a loud pronouncement. Each bullywug within 60 feet of the royal that can hear the pronouncement has advantage on its next attack roll.

info.text: The largest and most intelligent bullywugs invariably end up leading their kind. These sneering specimens dress in robes made from leather, rough cloth, and bits of marsh plants. As seen in Danger at Dunwater, a bullywug royal is often accompanied by and mounted astride a giant toad.

entries.name: Divine Eminence
entries.description: As a bonus action, Xendros can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Xendros expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Xendros is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). Xendros has the following cleric spells prepared:

Spellcasting ability: WIS.

Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy

Level 1 (4 slots): cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary

Level 2 (3 slots): lesser restoration, spiritual weapon

Level 3 (2 slots): dispel magic, spirit guardians

entries.name: Mace
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Bottom Treader
entries.description: The drowned ascetic cannot swim, and it sinks to the bottom of any body of water. It takes no penalties to its movement or attacks underwater. It is immune to the effects of being underwater at a depth greater than 100 feet.

entries.name: Bound Together
entries.description: The drowned ascetic shares its mind with every other drowned one within 1 mile of it, and can communicate its thoughts and observations to them instantaneously and without limitation.

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries.description: If damage reduces the drowned ascetic to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the drowned ascetic drops to 1 hit point instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The drowned ascetic makes three unarmed strikes.

entries.name: Unarmed Strike
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or contract bluerot [GoS] (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

entries.name: Dexterous Target
entries.description: The drowned ascetic adds 3 to its AC against one ranged attack that would hit it. To do so, the drowned ascetic must see the attacker.

info.text:
Dressed in tattered robes, its fists wrapped in long rib bons of rotting cloth, the drowned ascetic moves with alarming speed for an undead creature. This martial artist, rising from the ocean in Tammeraut's Fate, retains its fighting reflexes despite its rotting flesh.

Bluerot.

This disease targets humanoids. While afflicted with bluerot, a victim grows grotesque blue boils on their face and back. This disease is carried by undead (including the drowned ones in Tammeraut's Fate), and victims most often acquire it through wounds caused by infected creatures. The disease's boils manifest in 1d4 hours, causing the victim's Constitution and Charisma scores to decrease by 1d4 each, to a minimum of 3. This is quickly followed by a fever and tingling in the extremities. An infected creature is vulnerable to radiant damage and gains the ability to breathe underwater.

At the end of each long rest, an infected creature makes a 12 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the victim regains 1 point of Constitution and 1 point of Charisma lost to the disease. If the infected creature regains all the points lost to the disease, it is cured. Other effects that raise the victim's ability scores do not cure the disease. On a failed saving throw, the victim takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage as the boils burst and spread. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage cannot regain hit points until the disease is cured, though it can be stabilized as normal.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The drowned assassin makes two hand crossbow attacks or two dagger attacks. It can then take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

entries.name: Hand Crossbow
entries.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or contract bluerot [GoS] (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

entries.name: Dagger
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or contract bluerot [GoS] (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

entries.name: Reveal (1/Day)
entries.description: The drowned assassin removes its mask, revealing its rotting face. Each creature of the assassin's choice within 30 feet of it that can see the assassin must succeed on a 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

info.text:
The drowned assassin stalks and kills in a grim pantomime of its former occupation. Sneaking from shadow to shadow, and appearing in the undead assault of Tammeraut's Fate, it aims its barnacle-encrusted hand crossbow with deadly precision. Hidden behind a simple driftwood mask, this creature's face causes terror in mortal hearts when exposed.

entries.description: The drowned blade shares its mind with every other drowned one within 1 mile of it, and can communicate its thoughts and observations to them instantaneously and without limitation.

entries.description: If damage reduces the drowned blade to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the drowned blade drops to 1 hit point instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The drowned blade makes two rusted longsword attacks.

entries.name: Rusted Longsword
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or contract bluerot [GoS] (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

info.text:
Assaulting the hermitage in Tammeraut's Fate, this barnacle-encrusted undead warrior fights with surprising cunning. Starfish cling to its wispy beard, and its evil rage is visible in its bloated gray eyes.

This disease targets humanoids. While afflicted with bluerot, a victim grows grotesque blue boils on their face and back. This disease is carried by undead (including the drowned ones in Tammeraut's Fate), and victims most often acquire it through wounds caused by infected creatures. The disease's boils manifest in 1d4 hours, causing the victim's Constitution and Charisma scores to decrease by 1d4 each, to a minimum of 3. This is quickly followed by a fever and tingling in the extremities. An infected creature is vulnerable to radiant damage and gains the ability to breathe underwater.

At the end of each long rest, an infected creature makes a 12 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the victim regains 1 point of Constitution and 1 point of Charisma lost to the disease. If the infected creature regains all the points lost to the disease, it is cured. Other effects that raise the victim's ability scores do not cure the disease. On a failed saving throw, the victim takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage as the boils burst and spread. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage cannot regain hit points until the disease is cured, though it can be stabilized as normal.

entries.name: Bound Together
entries.description: The drowned master shares its mind with every other drowned one within 1 mile of it, and can communicate its thoughts and observations to them instantaneously and without limitation.

entries.name: Cold Aura
entries.description: At the start of each of the drowned master's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) cold damage. A creature that touches the drowned master or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries.description: If damage reduces the drowned master to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the drowned master drops to 1 hit point instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The drowned master makes two attacks: one with its greatsword and one with its Life-Draining Tentacle.

entries.name: Greatsword
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or contract bluerot [GoS] (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

entries.name: Life-Draining Tentacle
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. On a failed save, the target also contracts bluerot (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

entries.name: Necrotic Ink Recharge 5–6
entries.description: The drowned master discharges foul ink in front of itself in a 30-foot cone. Each creature caught in the ink must make a 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this saving throw is blinded until the end of its next turn and contracts bluerot (see the "Bluerot" in notes).

info.text:
This waterlogged undead, bound to the Pit of Hatred in Tammeraut's Fate, hovers menacingly over the bones of its victims. Its torso, arms, and head retain their former shapes, but its legs have split into shadowy tentacles. The drowned master is tethered to a source of powerful magic that prevents it from traveling far. It commands other drowned ones, compelling them to serve as agents in its dark plots.

Bluerot.

This disease targets humanoids. While afflicted with bluerot, a victim grows grotesque blue boils on their face and back. This disease is carried by undead (including the drowned ones in Tammeraut's Fate), and victims most often acquire it through wounds caused by infected creatures. The disease's boils manifest in 1d4 hours, causing the victim's Constitution and Charisma scores to decrease by 1d4 each, to a minimum of 3. This is quickly followed by a fever and tingling in the extremities. An infected creature is vulnerable to radiant damage and gains the ability to breathe underwater.

At the end of each long rest, an infected creature makes a 12 Constitution saving throw. On a success, the victim regains 1 point of Constitution and 1 point of Charisma lost to the disease. If the infected creature regains all the points lost to the disease, it is cured. Other effects that raise the victim's ability scores do not cure the disease. On a failed saving throw, the victim takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage as the boils burst and spread. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage cannot regain hit points until the disease is cured, though it can be stabilized as normal.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries.description: The fish can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. On a failed save, the target begins to hallucinate and is afflicted with a short-term madness [DMG] effect (determined randomly or by the DM; see "Madness" in chapter 8 of the Dungeon Master's Guide [dmg]). The effect lasts 10 minutes.

info.text: Comfortable on land or in water, these brilliantly colored snakes are renowned for their potent and hallucinogenic venom. They are most often found in coastal caves. In the abandoned chambers of the hermitage in Tammeraut's Fate, these giant serpents feed on any creature that crosses their path.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries.description: The eel can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage.

info.text: Snaking predators lurking in the dark waters of the ocean, these kelp-colored beasts serve as guards and mounts for the locathah (including those found in Danger at Dunwater).

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries.description: The eel can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Luring Maestro
entries.description: While within 60 feet of the matriarch, creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against the matriarch's Luring Song.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: The matriarch has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The matriarch makes two claws attacks.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Fleeting Form
entries.description: The matriarch can magically disguise itself to resemble a humanoid of roughly similar size and shape for up to 1 hour. It can revert to its true form as a bonus action. This illusion does not hold up to close scrutiny.

entries.name: Luring Song
entries.description:
The matriarch sings a magical melody. Every humanoid and giant within 300 feet of the matriarch that can hear the song must succeed on a 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends. The matriarch must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the matriarch is incapacitated.

While charmed by the matriarch, a target is incapacitated and ignores the songs of other harpies. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the matriarch, the target must move on its turn toward the matriarch by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the matriarch, the target can repeat the saving throw. A charmed target can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.

A target that successfully saves is immune to this matriarch's song for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Visage of Desire (1/Day)
entries.description: The matriarch projects a vision into the minds of creatures within 30 feet of it that aren't constructs or undead, showing each creature achieving whatever it most desires. An affected creature must succeed on a 14 Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

info.text: Happy to watch its flock squabble over carrion in Tammeraut's Fate, this gray-feathered matron of the harpies is surrounded by a cloud of magical spirits resembling skeletal seabirds.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: The kraken can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Freedom of Movement
entries.description: The kraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The kraken makes two tentacle attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of Fling.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature grappled by the kraken, that creature is swallowed and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns. One Medium or two smaller creatures can be swallowed at the same time.

If the kraken takes 35 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a 23 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in spaces within 10 feet of the kraken. If the kraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

entries.name: Tentacle
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape 20). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained. The kraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

entries.name: Fling
entries.description: One Medium or smaller object held or creature grappled by the kraken is thrown up to 40 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a 13 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

entries.name: Lightning Strike
entries.description: The kraken magically create a bolt of lightning, which can strike a target the kraken can see within 90 feet of it. The target must make a 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Tentacle Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: The kraken makes one tentacle attack.

entries.name: Fling
entries.description: The kraken uses Fling.

entries.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.description: While underwater, the kraken expels an ink cloud in a 40-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is heavily obscured to creatures other than the kraken. Each creature other than the kraken that ends its turn there must succeed on a 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of the kraken's next turn.

info.text: Hidden in a deep, dark underwater pit near the Styes, this creature bears the mark of the dark god Tharizdun's madness. Becoming more independent every day, it dreams of freeing itself from its aboleth tenders and wreaking its own foul will upon the seas.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: The koalinth can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Martial Advantage
entries.description: Once per turn, the koalinth can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the koalinth that isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Trident
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

info.text: The koalinth, found in Danger at Dunwater, are martial and aggressive aquatic hobgoblins, with brightly colored faces and functional gills. They are known for their ferocity, and for their hatred of elves.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: The koalinth can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Martial Advantage
entries.description: Once per turn, the sergeant can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the sergeant that isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The sergeant makes two melee attacks with its trident.

entries.name: Trident
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Hooked Net
entries.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 10/30 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is restrained. A creature can use its action to make a 12 Strength check to free itself or another creature in a hooked net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 12) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

entries.name: Spear the Helpless (2/Day)
entries.description: Whenever a creature within 30 feet of the sergeant becomes restrained, the sergeant can move its speed toward the restrained creature. If the sergeant ends its move within reach of the restrained creature, it can make a melee attack against it.

info.text: These fierce koalinths lead special missions for their people, such as the diplomatic envoy encountered in Danger at Dunwater. A koalinth sergeant focuses its ire on the most significant threats on the battlefield, then eliminates those threats one by one.

entries.name: Relentless Endurance
entries.description: When reduced to 0 hit points, Krell drops to 1 hit point instead (but can't do this again until they finish a long rest).

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Krell is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

Spellcasting ability: WIS.

Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, produce flame, shillelagh

Level 1 (4 slots): entangle, longstrider, speak with animals, thunderwave

Level 2 (3 slots): barkskin, flaming sphere

entries.name: Quarterstaff
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit (+4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Kysh can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Emissary of the Sea
entries.description: Kysh can communicate simple ideas with amphibious and water-breathing beasts. They understand the meaning of his words, but he cannot understand them in return.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Kysh's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). He can cast the following spell, requiring only verbal components:

Spellcasting ability: CHA.

1/day: fog cloud

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Kysh makes two melee attacks with his spear.

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft, one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

info.text: A prisoner of the sahuagin in The Final Enemy, Kysh is a defender of the deep sea realms who is ready to join the party in their struggle. Tritons are folk of the Elemental Plane of Water who journeyed to the Material Plane to watch over the dark places of the ocean depths. They stand guard over portals, deep sea chasms, and other places where foul monsters might emerge. When such threats appear, the tritons take up arms to drive them from the world.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries.description: The statue is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The statue makes two attacks: one with its blade and one with its hammer.

entries.name: Blade
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Hammer
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is knocked prone.

entries.name: Whirl Recharge 5–6
entries.description: The statue can use its action to spin at the waist, targeting creatures of its choice within 10 feet of it. Each target must make a 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 19 (3d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

info.text: This squat, solid-looking statue, currently guarding the evil cult's treasure in Isle of the Abbey, is made from pure iron. Its hands are shaped into deadly weapons.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries.description: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

info.text: These lizardfolk, found wandering the halls in Danger at Dunwater, are just as fierce as their armed kin, and can equip themselves with weapons and shields if such are available.

entries.name: Blood Frenzy
entries.description: The render has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries.description: The render can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The render makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its bite.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Rend the Field Recharge 5–6
entries.description: The render makes a claw attack against each creature of its choice within 10 feet of it. A creature hit by this attack must succeed on a 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

info.text: Filled with the primal magic of Semuanya, the lizardfolk render undergoes terrifying changes during a dayslong ritual performed by a shaman. As seen in Danger at Dunwater, the render's claws grow long and hard as steel, its frame enlarges, and its temperament becomes even more ferocious.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries.description: The scaleshield can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The scaleshield makes two melee attacks, each one with a different weapon.

entries.name: Morningstar
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Spiked Shield
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Shield Block
entries.description: If an ally within 5 feet of the scaleshield is hit by an attack, the scaleshield can reduce that attack's damage by half.

info.text: Serving as the elite warriors and officers of a lizardfolk clan, these robust creatures wear thick armor made from crocodile scales and metal. Trained in martial weapons and advanced combat tactics, they are found protecting lizardfolk lairs such as the one in Danger at Dunwater.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries.description: The subchief can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
The subchief is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

Spellcasting ability: WIS.

Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, spare the dying, thaumaturgy

Level 1 (4 slots): command, guiding bolt, purify food and drink

Level 2 (3 slots): hold person, lesser restoration, silence

Level 3 (2 slots): bestow curse, dispel magic

entries.name: Tooth Dagger
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Jaws of Semuanya Recharge 5–6
entries.description: The subchief invokes the primal magic of Semuanya, summoning a spectral maw around a target it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must make a 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this saving throw is also frightened until the end of its next turn.

info.text: The lizardfolk subchief (seen in Danger at Dunwater) is a devout priest of Semuanya, pursuing the worship of its god in a manner similar to a cleric. It wields a dagger crafted of a massive crocodile tooth blessed by Semuanya, representing the subchief's prowess in both battle and piety.

entries.name: Leviathan Will
entries.description: The locathah has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned, or put to sleep.

entries.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries.description: The locathah can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The locathah makes two melee attacks with its spear.

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands.

info.text: These resilient and proud fish-folk (found in Danger at Dunwater) have endured war, slavery, and mistreatment at the hands of other aquatic creatures. They dwell in submerged tribal communities along seacoasts, and hunt both above and below the water.

entries.name: Leviathan Will
entries.description: The hunter has advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that control its actions.

entries.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries.description: The hunter can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The hunter makes two attacks with its envenomed crossbow.

entries.name: Envenomed Crossbow
entries.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Club
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

info.text: The far-ranging locathah hunter is trained in tracking and stalking prey on land and in water. They often serve as leaders to small bands of locathah or emissaries for their people (such as the hunter found in Danger at Dunwater). Their colorful, poisoned, and fast-loading crossbows rarely miss a target.

entries.name: Divine Eminence
entries.description: As a bonus action, Refrum can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Refrum expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Refrum is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). Refrum has the following cleric spells prepared:

Spellcasting ability: WIS.

Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy

Level 1 (4 slots): cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary

Level 2 (3 slots): lesser restoration, spiritual weapon

Level 3 (2 slots): dispel magic, spirit guardians

entries.name: Mace
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries.description: If the maw of Sekolah fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries.description: The maw of Sekolah can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The maw of Sekolah makes one attack with its bite and one attack with its tail smash.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

entries.name: Tail Smash
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Detect
entries.description: The maw of Sekolah makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

entries.name: Speed of Sekolah
entries.description: The maw of Sekolah moves up to its speed.

entries.name: Feed (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: The ferocious spirit of Sekolah flashes through the water, tearing through the foes of the maw of Sekolah. Each creature of the maw's choosing within 60 feet of it must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

info.text: Summoned from the shadowy depths of the ocean through ritual and tidal magic, the Maw of Sekolah appears in The Final Enemy as the avatar of the hungry sahuagin god. This huge, two-headed shark is fed a steady diet of sentient creatures, captured by the sahuagin and offered up as tribute. Sahuagin priestesses adorn the fins of the maw of Sekolah with gemmed bands and polished skulls.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: The salvager can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The salvager makes two attacks with its coral rapier.

entries.name: Coral Rapier
entries.description: m Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Inject Toxin (2/Day)
entries.description: m Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, and the creature must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

info.text: Veterans of scouring the wrecks and ruins found in the deepest waters, these skilled warriors help defend their kin with rapier-like weapons of living coral. The salvagers escort other merfolk on scavenging missions, using their keen senses to detect danger. They are found allying with the lizardfolk in Danger at Dunwater.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries.description: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: The merfolk scout can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries.description: The statue is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The statue makes two attacks: one with its greataxe and one gore attack.

entries.name: Greataxe
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Gore
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Flying Shards
entries.description: In response to a creature hitting the statue with a melee weapon attack, the statue deals 11 (2d10) piercing damage to the attacker.

info.text: Given life through powerful magic, a large, crudely carved crystal minotaur guards the tunnels in Isle of the Abbey.

entries.name: Flyby
entries.description: The peryton doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

entries.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries.description: The peryton has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: If the peryton fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The peryton makes two attacks: one with its gore and one with its talons.

entries.name: Gore
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage.

entries.name: Talons
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.

entries.name: Warp Shadow
entries.description: The peryton chooses up to three creatures within 60 feet of it that it can see. Each creature must succeed on a 14 Wisdom saving throw or become cursed. While cursed, whenever the creature makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, it must roll a d4 and subtract that number from the roll. A cursed creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a success. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to this peryton's Warp Shadow for 24 hours.

entries.name: Detect
entries.description: The peryton makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

entries.name: Talons Attack
entries.description: The peryton makes one attack with its talons.

entries.name: Dive Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: The peryton moves up to its speed toward one target of its choosing. It then makes a gore attack that deals an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage on a hit.

info.text: The terror of the coast and the recent scourge of Firewatch Island in Tammeraut's Fate, this large peryton preys on ships and coastal communities alike. It has built numerous nests to mark its territory.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Mr. Dory has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Water Dependency
entries.description: Mr. Dory takes 6 (1d12) acid damage at the end of every hour he goes without exposure to water.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Mr. Dory's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (save 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). Mr. Dory can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

Spellcasting ability: CHA.

At will: detect magic, detect thoughts, invisibility (self only)

2/day each: fear, fireball, fly

1/day each: cloudkill, etherealness

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Mr. Dory makes three attacks with his rapier.

entries.name: Rapier
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

entries.name: Eye of Corruption Recharge 5–6
entries.description: Mr. Dory glares at a creature he can see within 30 feet of him. The target must make a 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 27 (5d10) necrotic damage and 27 (5d10) poison damage and then gains vulnerability to both necrotic and poison damage for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half damage and does not gain the vulnerabilities.

info.text: One of the four councillors who rule the Styes, Mr. Dory hides his cursed nature in plain sight. His rare, liquid-sensitive "skin condition" is actually a form of the same aboleth affliction that creates skum, though Dory's condition is not as severe, and he has managed to retain his free will.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Oceanus can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Friend of the Sea
entries.description: Using gestures and sounds, Oceanus can communicate simple ideas with any beast that has an innate swimming speed.

entries.name: Trident
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Light Crossbow
entries.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

info.text: Before being captured, this sea elf had been tasked with investigating the Sea Ghost's movements in The Sinister Secret of Saltmarsh. Oceanus is a smart and resourceful elf who is more than willing to join adventurers who have brave hearts and good intentions.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries.description: Othokent can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

entries.name: Skewer
entries.description: Once per turn, when Othokent makes a melee attack with its trident and hits, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage, and Othokent gains temporary hit points equal to the extra damage dealt.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Othokent makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or trident or two melee attacks with its trident.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Trident
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Cargo Hauler
entries.description: The bosun has advantage on Strength checks.

entries.name: Sea Legs
entries.description: The bosun has advantage on ability checks and saving throws to resist being knocked prone.

entries.name: Light Hammer
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Hook
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape 13).

info.text: The bosun (or boatswain) is tasked with organizing the cargo and crew aboard a ship. Bosuns are capable fighters whose experience with hauling cargo and delivering beatings make them tough opponents. Foul Frithoff in The Sinister Secret of Saltmarsh is the bosun who protects the cargo aboard the smugglers' ship. Ever since a bad accident, he has worn a hook at the end of one arm in place of a hand.

entries.name: Flourish
entries.description: The captain adds its Charisma modifier to the damage roll for its longsword attacks (included in the attack).

entries.name: Sea Legs
entries.description: The captain has advantage on ability checks and saving throws to resist being knocked prone.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The captain makes two attacks: one with its hand crossbow and one with its longsword.

entries.name: Hand Crossbow
entries.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Longsword
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, or 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage if used with two hands.

entries.name: Shape Up, Ye Dog (2/Day)
entries.description: Whenever a friendly creature within 30 feet of the captain that can hear it misses with an attack, the captain can yell perilous threats to allow that creature to reroll the attack roll.

info.text: Pirate captains spend their lives at sea, earning and keeping command through blood and daring. A captain's impressive sword work and biting words inspire both confidence and fear in a ship's crew. Sigurd "Snake Eyes" is the pirate captain who leads a gang of smugglers in The Sinister Secret of Saltmarsh.

entries.name: Sea Legs
entries.description: The deck wizard has advantage on ability checks and saving throws to resist being knocked prone.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
The deck wizard is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:

Spellcasting ability: INT.

Cantrips (at will): friends, mage hand, prestidigitation, ray of frost

Level 1 (4 slots): disguise self, fog cloud, mage armor, witch bolt

Level 2 (3 slots): gust of wind, Melf's acid arrow, misty step

entries.name: Quarterstaff
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

info.text: These salt-encrusted practitioners of magic are at once learned and superstitious. The crews of pirate ships generally give their deck wizards a wide berth, as they magically step from place to place and unleash their briny magic against attackers. The ship Sea Ghost in The Sinister Secret of Saltmarsh is home to a pirate deck wizard named Punketah.

entries.name: Sea Legs
entries.description: The first mate has advantage on ability checks and saving throws to resist being knocked prone.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The first mate makes two attacks with its longsword.

entries.name: Longsword
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands. If the target is a creature, the first mate can choose to deal no damage with the attack to disarm the target. The target must succeed on a 14 Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding on the ground.

info.text: These no-nonsense sailors are the trusted allies of a pirate ship's captain. Ex-soldiers and trained mercenaries often find employment as mates aboard pirate ships. In The Sinister Secret of Saltmarsh, Bloody Bjorn serves as the first mate aboard Sea Ghost.

entries.name: Quarterstaff
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
The priest is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following sorcerer spells:

Spellcasting ability: CHA.

Cantrips (at will): chill touch, mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation, ray of frost

Level 1 (4 slots): expeditious retreat, magic missile, shield

Level 2 (3 slots): blur, hold person

Level 3 (2 slots): sleet storm

info.text: Priests of the Rip Tide cult gather in secret cabals to perform dark rituals that glorify Olhydra, the elemental Princess of Evil Water, as the embodiment of water's destructiveness. They believe that using water to kill their enemies, such as through ritual drowning, earns them Olhydra's favor.

entries.name: Blood Frenzy
entries.description: The blademaster has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

entries.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries.description: The blademaster can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

entries.name: Shark Telepathy
entries.description: The blademaster can magically command any shark within 120 feet of it, using a limited telepathy.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The blademaster makes three attacks with its wavecutter blade, or one attack with its bite and two with its claws.

entries.name: Wavecutter Blade
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

info.text: A cunning veteran of countless campaigns, the sahuagin blademaster decorates its armor with the bones of its defeated foes. As demonstrated in The Final Enemy, sahuagin blademasters often serve as officers in the sahuagin army.

entries.name: Blood Frenzy
entries.description: The champion has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

entries.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries.description: The champion can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

entries.name: Shark Telepathy
entries.description: The champion can magically command any shark within 120 feet of it, using a limited telepathy.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The champion makes three attacks with its spear, or one attack with its bite and two with its claws.

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

info.text: Those sahuagin warriors who prove themselves through heroic acts are given both title and status. Sahuagin champions often serve as lieutenants in the sahuagin army, as they do in The Final Enemy.

entries.name: Blood Frenzy
entries.description: The coral smasher has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

entries.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries.description: The coral smasher can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

entries.name: Shark Telepathy
entries.description: The coral smasher can magically command any shark within 120 feet of it, using a limited telepathy.

entries.name: Siege Monster
entries.description: The coral smasher deals double damage to objects and structures.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The coral smasher makes two attacks with its warhammer, or one attack with its bite and one with its claws.

entries.name: Warhammer
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

info.text: Employed as frontline brutes in The Final Enemy, coral smashers are drawn from the ranks of the strongest sahuagin warriors. Their physical strength overcomes the resistance of the water as they swing their hammers at structures and foes with equal zeal.

entries.name: Blood Frenzy
entries.description: The deep diver has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

entries.name: Brine Lurker
entries.description: The deep diver has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while submerged in water.

entries.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries.description: The deep diver can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

entries.name: Lure
entries.description: The deep diver can cause its lure to light up or darken at will. While the lure is lit, the deep diver sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius centered on itself and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

entries.name: Shark Telepathy
entries.description: The deep diver can magically command any shark within 120 feet of it, using a limited telepathy.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The deep diver makes two attacks with its glaive, or one attack with its bite and two with its claws.

entries.name: Glaive
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Light of Sekolah
entries.description: The deep diver pulses magical light from its lure. Any creature within 30 feet of the deep diver that can see the light must succeed on a 11 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the end of its next turn. A creature charmed in this way is incapacitated as it stares at the light.

info.text: These mighty sahuagin, found in The Final Enemy, are transformed by the divine magic of Sekolah to enable them to better explore the darkest depths of the ocean. Out of the water, they cling to shadows and serve as hunters and assassins. A long, scaly lure that can be illuminated extends from a deep diver's forehead.

entries.name: Blood Frenzy
entries.description: The swarm has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

entries.name: Seething
entries.description: Once it enters combat, the swarm deals 10 slashing damage to itself at the end of its turn if it did not make an attack on that turn. This damage ignores resistance, and it cannot reduce the swarm to 0 hit points.

entries.name: Swarm
entries.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries.description: The swarm can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Bites
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

info.text: Roiling through the waters in The Final Enemy, these swarms of sahuagin hatchlings are dangerous to any creatures they encounter. Other sahuagin avoid the swarms, while the individual members devour one another until only the strongest hatchlings are left alive to grow to maturity.

entries.name: Blood Frenzy
entries.description: The high priestess has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

entries.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries.description: The high priestess can breathe air and water, but she needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

entries.name: Shark Telepathy
entries.description: The high priestess can magically command any shark within 120 feet of her, using a limited telepathy.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
The high priestess is a 7th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following cleric spells prepared:

Spellcasting ability: WIS.

Cantrips (at will): guidance, mending, resistance, thaumaturgy

Level 1 (4 slots): bless, detect magic, guiding bolt

Level 2 (3 slots): hold person, spiritual weapon (trident)

Level 3 (3 slots): bestow curse, fear, mass healing word, tongues

Level 4 (1 slots): banishment

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The high priestess makes two attacks with her toothsome staff, or one attack with her bite and one with her claws.

entries.name: Toothsome Staff
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

info.text: A sahuagin high priestess is the most devout and ferocious of all Sekolah's worshipers. Armed with a staff studded with jagged shark's teeth, she can be seen leading dark rituals in The Final Enemy.

entries.name: Blood Frenzy
entries.description: The wave shaper has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

entries.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries.description: The wave shaper can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

entries.name: Shark Telepathy
entries.description: The wave shaper can magically command any shark within 120 feet of it, using a limited telepathy.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
The wave shaper's spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

Spellcasting ability: INT.

At will: message

1/day: comprehend languages

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The wave shaper makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) cold damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) cold damage.

entries.name: Whirlpool (1/Day)
entries.description:
The wave shaper targets a body of water at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep, causing a whirlpool to form in the center of the area.
