The whirlpool forms a vortex that is 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, 25 feet tall, and lasts for 1 minute or until the wave shaper is incapacitated. Any creature or object in the water and within 25 feet of the vortex is pulled 10 feet toward it. A creature can swim away from the vortex by succeeding on a 14 Strength (Athletics) check.

When a creature enters the vortex for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a 14 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and is caught in the vortex until it ends. On a success, the creature takes half damage and isn't caught in the vortex. A creature caught in the vortex can use its action to try to swim away from the vortex as described above, but it has disadvantage on the Strength (Athletics) check to do so.

The first time each turn that an object enters the vortex, the object takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage. This damage occurs each round it remains in the vortex.

info.text: These hunched and twisted sahuagin sacrifice their bodies to the mutating magic of Sekolah. Wave shapers add elemental magic to sahuagin armed forces (as seen in The Final Enemy) and delight in creating destructive whirlpools.

entries.name: Dagger
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Sanbalet is a 3rd-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

Spellcasting ability: INT.

Cantrips (at will): dancing lights, minor illusion, ray of frost

Level 1 (4 slots): charm person, color spray, magic missile, silent image

Level 2 (2 slots): magic mouth, scorching ray

info.text: In The Sinister Secret of Saltmarsh, Sanbalet is the leader of the land-based half of a smuggling ring. He is a cunning narcissist with an interest in illusion and mind control. He defends the contraband stored in the caves under the haunted house.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries.description: Sauriv can hold their breath for up to 15 minutes at a time.

entries.name: Rapier
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Parry
entries.description: Sauriv adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Sauriv must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

entries.name: Blood Frenzy
entries.description: The shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: The shark has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries.description: The shark can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The shark makes two bite attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage.

info.text: These impressive creatures, swimming through the sahuagin stronghold in The Final Enemy, are chosen by priestesses of Sekolah to serve as protectors and messengers. The sharks are blessed in a ritual during which plates of shell and coral are permanently affixed to their bodies.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: The skeletal alchemist has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The skeletal alchemist makes two Lob Acid attacks.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

entries.name: Lob Acid
entries.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) acid damage.

info.text: This undead retains enough of its former self to continue its alchemical work, often on behalf of necromancers or other sinister patrons. It toils in a dark laboratory (such as the one found in The Sinister Secret of Saltmarsh), often falling dormant for long periods of time.

entries.name: Disassemble
entries.description: If the juggernaut is reduced to 0 hit points, twelve skeletons rise from its remains.

entries.name: Falling Apart
entries.description: If the juggernaut does not have all of its hit points at the start of its turn, it loses 10 hit points.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The juggernaut makes two claws attacks.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Avalanche of Bones Recharge 5–6
entries.description: The juggernaut collapses into a large heap before quickly reforming. Each creature within 10 feet of the juggernaut must make a 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this saving throw is also knocked prone.

info.text: As seen lumbering across the beaches in Isle of the Abbey, a skeletal juggernaut is an oversized, bipedal assembly of bones that loses a portion of its mass with each step. These skeletal guardians hold together for only a short time before disassembling into a gang of individual undead.

entries.name: Deafening Clatter
entries.description: Creatures are deafened while in the swarm's space.

entries.name: Swarm
entries.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Small humanoid. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

entries.name: Slash
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

info.text: This swarm of bones found rising out of the sand in Isle of the Abbey is made from the remains of several animated skeletons. A skeletal swarm alternates its appearance between partially formed humanoid shapes and a chaotic, swirling mass.

entries.name: Abolethic Vassal
entries.description: The skum is permanently charmed by its aboleth master.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: The skum can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Psychic Conditioning
entries.description: The skum is immune to the frightened and charmed conditions unless they are from effects created by an aboleth.

entries.name: Water Dependency
entries.description: The skum takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes it goes without exposure to water.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The skum makes three attacks: two with its trident and one with its Mind-Breaking Touch.

entries.name: Trident
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Mind-Breaking Touch
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage, and the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws until the end of the skum's next turn.

info.text: Several poor souls around the Styes have succumbed to an aboleth's magic through its disease-bearing touch. Transformed into creatures called skum, they barely resemble their past forms, their skin turning slimy and translucent while their limbs warp to resemble those of deep-sea oddities. The change makes them dependent on water, which they must immerse themselves in regularly lest they experience painful-and potentially lethal-skin eruptions. Skum are bound to their aboleth master not just by their cursed state, but by a psychic bond that compels them to serve its every sinister whim.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries.description: Thousand Teeth can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries.description: If Thousand Teeth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Thousand Teeth makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Tail
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Detect
entries.description: Thousand Teeth makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

entries.name: Lunge
entries.description: Thousand Teeth moves up to half its speed.

entries.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Thousand Teeth makes a bite attack.

info.text: Thousand Teeth is an ancient crocodilian nightmare that has served as the apex predator in the swamps near Saltmarsh for as long as anyone can remember. This monster recently fought a number of lizardfolk and lost one of its teeth. Angered and hungry, it sulks in its lair, lost in primal dreams of rending and tearing. It is found in the deep marshes in Danger at Dunwater.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries.description: The statue is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: If the statue fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The statue makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, that creature becomes cursed by the statue. The curse lasts for 10 minutes. While the creature is cursed, the statue has advantage on all attacks against it.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: The statue makes one bite attack.

entries.name: Blood Reaper
entries.description: All creatures currently cursed by the statue and within 20 feet of it take 5 necrotic damage.

entries.name: Move
entries.description: The statue moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

info.text: A large, exquisitely carved jade statue of a vampire guards the tunnels in Isle of the Abbey, having been brought to life by dark magic. Its stone fangs draw blood that it then uses to work a curse on its victims.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries.description: While in sunlight, Yalaga has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Yalaga's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 15). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

Spellcasting ability: CHA.

At will: dancing lights

1/day each: darkness, faerie fire, levitate (self only)

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Yalaga is a 10th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (save 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Yalaga has the following cleric spells prepared:

Spellcasting ability: WIS.

Cantrips (at will): guidance, poison spray, resistance, spare the dying, thaumaturgy

Level 1 (4 slots): animal friendship, cure wounds, detect poison and disease, ray of sickness

Level 2 (3 slots): lesser restoration, protection from poison, web

Level 3 (3 slots): conjure animals (2 giant spiders [mm]), dispel magic

Level 4 (3 slots): divination, freedom of movement

Level 5 (2 slots): insect plague, mass cure wounds

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Yalaga makes two scourge attacks.

entries.name: Scourge
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) poison damage.

entries.name: Air Form
entries.description: The apparition can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The apparition makes two slam attacks.

entries.name: Slam
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) acid damage.

entries.name: Whirlwind Recharge 4–6
entries.description:
Each creature in the apparition's space must make a 13 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and is flung up 20 feet away from the apparition in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes an object, such as a wall or floor, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a 13 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

If the saving throw is successful, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't flung away or knocked prone.

info.source: Giants of the Star Forge, page 6

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Doric makes two Shaped Claw or Sling attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

entries.name: Shaped Claw
entries.description: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Sling
entries.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Doric casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 15):

Spellcasting ability: WIS.

At will: animal messenger, beast sense, speak with animals

2/day each: cure wounds, entangle, faerie fire, thunderwave

entries.name: Change Shape (5/Day)
entries.description:
Doric magically transforms into a Beast with a challenge rating of 3 or less or into an owlbear (see the Monster Manual).

Doric can remain in that form for up to 2 hours. She can choose whether her equipment falls to the ground, melds with her new form, or is worn by the new form. Doric reverts to her true form if she is incapacitated or dies. She can revert to her true form using a bonus action.

While Doric is transformed, her stat block is replaced by the stat block of that form, except she keeps her current hit points, her hit point maximum, this bonus action, her alignment, and her Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.

entries.name: Fiery Rebuke (3/Day)
entries.description: When Doric is damaged by a creature that she can see within 60 feet of herself, she magically engulfs the creature in flames. The creature must make a 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) fire damage on failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

info.text:
The tiefling Doric was taken in by a wood elf enclave in Neverwinter Wood after being abandoned as a child, and she guards her adoptive community with nature's ferocity. The Circle of the Moon has taught her to heed her primal instincts, which rarely lead her astray. She can be brusque, but she will fight tooth and nail for a cause she believes in.

Doric has joined the Emerald Enclave, a network of survivalists who tend to the balance between civilization and nature. When the Lord of Neverwinter targeted her woodland home for its resources, Doric rallied the resistance.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Edgin makes two Reinforced Lute or Shortsword attacks.

entries.name: Reinforced Lute
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) thunder damage.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) thunder damage.

entries.name: Disorienting Words
entries.description: Edgin magically taunts up to three creatures he can see within 60 feet of himself. Each creature must succeed on a 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of Edgin's next turn.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Edgin casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 15):

Spellcasting ability: CHA.

At will: friends, message

1/day: suggestion

3/day each: charm person, disguise self

entries.name: Inspiring Words (3/Day)
entries.description: When a creature Edgin can see within 60 feet of himself fails an ability check, an attack roll, or a saving throw, Edgin grants the creature magical encouragement. The creature can roll a d8 and add the number rolled to the total, potentially turning the failure into a success.

info.text:
Edgin Darvis has a talent for improvisation and strategy. He's a musician and tale-teller who relies on charisma first—rather than magic or muscle—to escape trouble. Once a member of the Harpers, a spy organization dedicated to protecting Faerûn's common folk, Edgin has forsworn his oath and turned to thievery to support his family. Edgin's strong moral compass compels him to steal only from people he believes deserve to lose both coin and face.

Edgin's confidence and rakish demeanor make him a natural leader. With carefully chosen words, he inspires the members of his thieves' crew to greatness. But when his past mistakes come calling, Edgin must face the music. He now seeks to make amends to those he's wronged and to confront those who have wronged him.

entries.name: Disarming Charm
entries.description: While Forge isn't wearing armor, his AC includes his Charisma modifier.

entries.name: Double-Cross
entries.description: If Forge hits a creature friendly to him with an attack roll, the attack is automatically a critical hit.

entries.name: Evasion
entries.description: If Forge is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails, provided he isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Forge makes two Dagger attacks, two Heavy Crossbow attacks, or one of each.

entries.name: Dagger
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) poison damage, and the target is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) poison damage. Hit or Miss:If the target is a creature, it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of Forge's next turn.

entries.name: Cunning
entries.description: Forge takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action, or he gives himself advantage on the next attack roll he makes before the end of this turn.

entries.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries.description: Forge halves the damage he takes from an attack that hits him. He must be able to see the attacker.

info.text:
Forge Fitzwilliam is a con artist who manipulates others with lies and flattery. The audacious criminal has left a trail of broken promises and false identities along the Sword Coast. He conceals flexible morals and a ready dagger behind his winning smile.

Forge enjoys the finer things in life, particularly when they result from his own cleverness. Decades of heists and cons haven't slaked his thirst—in fact, his ambitions only grow grander with time.

entries.name: Reckless
entries.description: At the start of her turn, Holga can gain advantage on melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against her have advantage until the start of her next turn.

entries.name: Special Equipment
entries.description: Holga carries a darksteel greataxe, a magic weapon that grants her resistance to lightning damage while she carries it (included above).

entries.name: Unarmored Defense
entries.description: While Holga isn't wearing armor, her AC includes her Constitution modifier.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Holga makes three Darksteel Greataxe or Improvised Weapon attacks, in any combination.

entries.name: Darksteel Greataxe
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Improvised Weapon
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Wrestle
entries.description: Holga shoves a creature within 5 feet of herself. That creature must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or be moved 5 feet into an unoccupied space of Holga's choice.

info.text:
Holga Kilgore is a member of the Uthgardt Elk Tribe, and her strength and scowl conceal a generous heart. She's a woman of few words who lets her actions (and punches) speak for her. A fearsome combatant when her ire is up, Holga wields anything that comes to hand—from weapons to snacks. Her unwavering loyalty makes her a fierce defender of allies, particularly her best friend, Edgin.

After Holga was exiled from her clan, she wandered unmoored and craving connection. Now that she has forged a new home with Edgin and his band of thieves, she won't lose another family without a fight.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries.description: Simon has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the charmed condition on himself, and magic can't put him to sleep.

entries.name: Special Equipment
entries.description: Simon carries a bag of holding, two pairs of sending stones, and a deathly token (see Spellcasting).

entries.name: Wild Magic
entries.description: When Simon takes 20 or more damage from a single source or takes damage from a critical hit, he must roll on the Wild Magic Surge table in the Player's Handbook.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Simon makes three Quarterstaff or Chaos Bolt attacks. He can replace one attack with one use of Spellcasting.

entries.name: Quarterstaff
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

entries.name: Chaos Bolt
entries.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) damage of a random type determined by rolling a d8: 1, acid; 2, cold; 3, fire; 4, force; 5, lightning; 6, poison; 7, psychic; 8, thunder.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Roll a d6. On a roll of 1, Simon must roll on the Wild Magic Surge table in the Player's Handbook. On a roll of 2 or higher, Simon casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 14):

Spellcasting ability: CHA.

At will: mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation, speak with dead (Simon must be holding his deathly token to cast this spell)

2/day each: fog cloud, mage armor, magic missile, spider climb

1/day each: Bigby's hand, major image

entries.name: Sheltering Shield (3/Day)
entries.description: When Simon or another creature he can see within 10 feet of himself would take damage, he conjures a shimmering, 10-foot-radius sphere of magical force centered on himself. Creatures inside the sphere have resistance to the damage that triggered this reaction.

info.text:
Simon Aumar suffers under the weight of his family name. Though he is a descendent of an elf and the legendary wizard Elminster Aumar, Simon's own sorcerous wild magic runs uncontrolled through his veins. Simon has not yet developed the ability to harness his power, and his spells explode or fizzle seemingly at random.

Though he's dogged by doubt, the brave young mage has earned his place in Edgin's crew. He performs best under pressure, instinctively unleashing his magic in dire moments. How he will continue to unlock his potential and what he will do with his volatile gift are yet to be seen.

entries.name: Special Equipment
entries.description: Sofina wears a magic robe that grants her a +2 bonus to AC and a +1 bonus to saving throws (included above).

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Sofina makes three Necrotic Strike attacks.

entries.name: Necrotic Strike
entries.description: Melee Spell or Ranged Spell Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) necrotic damage.

entries.name: Swarm of Meteors (1/Day)
entries.description: Sofina magically calls down a meteor swarm that detonates in four 40-foot-radius spheres, each one centered on a point she can see within 1 mile of herself. These spheres can overlap. Each creature in one or more of these spheres must make a 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage and 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature in multiple spheres takes this damage only once.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Sofina casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 18):

Spellcasting ability: INT.

At will: mage hand, message, prestidigitation

2/day each: bestow curse, Bigby's hand, dimension door, mage armor, Otiluke's resilient sphere, thunderwave

1/day each: Evard's black tentacles, finger of death, time stop

entries.name: Summon Wraith (1/Day)
entries.description: Sofina magically summons the spirit of a Thayan assassin, which appears as a wraith (see the Monster Manual). The summoned wraith appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Sofina, whom it obeys. The summoned wraith takes its turn immediately after Sofina. It lasts for 1 hour, until it or Sofina dies, or until Sofina dismisses it as a bonus action.

info.text:
Sofina is a Red Wizard of Thay, an elite practitioner of magic with ties to Thay's tyrannical magocracy. Sofina specializes in necromancy. Death magic and fear are both tools in her arsenal.

As Red Wizards are shunned outside Thay, Sofina conceals her affiliations and coldly rebuffs any who seek her friendship. A canny operator, she has patiently moved her pieces into place, and her grand designs now begin to take shape.

entries.name: Aura of Protection
entries.description: Xenk and his allies within 10 feet of him have advantage on saving throws.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Xenk makes three Daggersword attacks and uses Daggersword Flourish. He can replace Daggersword Flourish with Cleansing Touch if it's available.

entries.name: Daggersword
entries.description: Choose the attack that corresponds to the daggersword's current form (see Daggersword Shift below):

entries.name: Longsword
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 6 (1d12) radiant damage.

entries.name: Shortsword and Dagger
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 6 (1d12) radiant damage.

entries.name: Daggersword Flourish
entries.description: Choose the option that corresponds to the daggersword's current form (see Daggersword Shift below):

entries.name: Longsword
entries.description: Xenk magically detaches the longsword's blade from its hilt, launching the blade at a creature he can see within 30 feet of himself. The target must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target is impaled by the blade, taking 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage, and is knocked prone. At the end of the current turn, the blade magically reattaches to its hilt.

entries.name: Shortsword and Dagger
entries.description: Xenk lashes out with both weapons. Each creature of his choice within 10 feet of him must make a 16 Dexterity throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of Xenk's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

entries.name: Cleansing Touch (1/Day)
entries.description: Xenk touches a creature within 5 feet of himself. The target magically regains 27 (6d8) hit points and gains the benefit of a lesser restoration spell.

entries.name: Daggersword Shift
entries.description: Xenk changes the form of his daggersword, choosing one of the following forms: a longsword, or a shortsword in one hand and a dagger in the other.

info.text:
Raised in the nation of Thay, Xenk Yendar has sworn an oath of devotion to aid the innocent. Every inch the knight in shining armor, he thrives when inspiring goodness in his allies. The words "Neither virtue nor blade shall break" are etched in Celestial on the blade of his daggersword.

Xenk ages more slowly than a normal human, and with this gift comes the burden of perspective. His longevity has something to do with Szass Tam's nightmarish rise to power and Xenk's narrow escape from the lich.

Now based in Mornbryn's Shield, Xenk travels Faerûn in search of evil to thwart. He approaches problems with absolute seriousness of purpose—an outlook that clashes with Edgin's nonchalance.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries.description: The demogorgon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Blood Frenzy
entries.description: The demogorgon has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: The demogorgon regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the demogorgon takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the demogorgon's next turn. The demogorgon dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The demogorgon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

info.text: A predator of the Upside Down, the demogorgon hunts the dimension looking for unfortunate creatures that find their way there. The size and shape of an adult humanoid, the demogorgon's mouth encompasses its face and unfolds like a blossoming flower

entries.name: Quarterstaff
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d8 -1) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
The mage is a 4th-level spellcaster that uses Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The mage knows the following spells from the wizard's spell list:

Spellcasting ability: INT.

Cantrips (at will): light, mage hand, shocking grasp

Level 1 (4 slots): charm person, magic missile

Level 2 (3 slots): hold person, misty step

info.text: Evil mages hunger for arcane power and dwell in isolated places, where they can perform terrible magical experiments without interference.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The thessalhydra makes one maw attack and one Flurry of Bites.

entries.name: Flurry of Bites
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (4d4) poison damage.

entries.name: Maw
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) acid damage.

entries.name: Tail Pincer
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage, and the target is grappled. As an action, the target can escape the grapple by succeeding on a 14 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (its choice). Until this grapple ends, the thessalhydra can't use its tail pincer.

entries.name: Acid Saliva Recharge 5–6
entries.description: The thessalhydra spits a glob of acid at a point it can see within 30 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

sections.title: Legendary Actions
sections.description: Legendary actions: 2.

entries.name: Detect
entries.description: The thessalhydra makes a Wisdom (Perception) check with advantage.

entries.name: Tail Swipe
entries.description: The thessalhydra makes a tail pincer attack.

info.text: The thessalhydra is a strange and terrible creature with eight heads surrounding a large, circular mouth rimmed with jagged teeth. Its maw drips with acid, and its tail ends with a pair of sharp pincers. The thessalhydra is gluttonous and damaging to any environment.

entries.name: Quarterstaff
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

entries.name: Burning Hands (1st-Level Spell; 2/Day)
entries.description: You shoot forth a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in that area must make a 11 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

entries.name: Fire Bolt (Cantrip)
entries.description: Ranged Spell Attack: Ranged Spell Attack: +3 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
You cast one of the following wizard spells (spell save 11), using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

Spellcasting ability: INT.

At will: minor illusion, Fire Bolt

hidden: 

2/day: grease

2/day each: Burning Hands

hidden:

entries.name: Mace
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Sacred Flame (Cantrip)
entries.description: You target one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 4 (1d8) radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
You cast one the following cleric spells (spell save 11), using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:

Spellcasting ability: WIS.

At will: guidance, Sacred Flame

hidden: 

2/day: cure wounds

entries.name: Dagger
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Disengage
entries.description: You take the Disengage action.

entries.name: Longsword
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage if used with two hands.

entries.name: Shove
entries.description: While wielding a shield, you try to shove one creature within 5 feet of you.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: The curate has Advantage [XPHB] on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Raise the Dead (1/Day)
entries.description: In a ritual that takes 8 hours, the curate touches a creature that has died within the past 7 days. That creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point [XPHB]. The curate can't revive a creature that died of old age.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The curate makes three Celestial Radiance attacks.

entries.name: Celestial Radiance
entries.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

entries.name: Healer's Touch (2/Day)
entries.description: The curate touches another creature. That creature regains 13 (2d8 + 4) Hit Points [XPHB].

info.text: A curate earns a special connection to the divine through service to shrines and temples. This devotion endows these spiritual leaders with the power to heal injuries, repel evil, and raise the dead.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries.description: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

entries.name: Corrosive Form
entries.description: Whenever a creature hits the ooze with a melee attack, that creature takes 2 Acid damage.

entries.name: Pseudopod
entries.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) Acid damage.

info.text: Gray oozes are predatory, corrosive slimes that blend in with stony surroundings. Unpredictable magic and other chaotic forces can cause these oozes to split, creating smaller, unstable globs.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Ivlis makes three Chaos Blast attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Sinister Command if available.

entries.name: Chaos Blast
entries.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) damage. Roll 1d4 to determine the damage type: 1, Acid; 2, Cold; 3, Fire; 4, Lightning.

entries.name: Sinister Command Recharge 5–6
entries.description: WIS Saving Throw: 12, one creature Ivlis can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed [XPHB] condition until the end of its next turn. While Charmed [XPHB], the target has the Incapacitated [XPHB] condition.

info.text: Beneath a pretense of charity and goodness, Ivlis is a demon worshiper who leads a wicked cult. She uses deception and skulduggery to advance her power. Though she feigns kindness and compassion in public spaces, Ivlis believes the poor and downtrodden deserve their wretched lot. In battle, her magic is unpredictable.

entries.name: Quick Disguise
entries.description: Jacko spends 1 minute to disguise himself as a different Humanoid of approximately his height and weight. While Jacko is disguised, a creature that takes the Study [XPHB] action to inspect Jacko's appearance can make a 13 Intelligence (Investigation [XPHB]) check, discerning his disguise on a successful check.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Jacko makes two Poison Dagger attacks.

entries.name: Poison Dagger
entries.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

entries.name: Cunning Action
entries.description: Jacko takes the Dash [XPHB], Disengage [XPHB], or Hide [XPHB] action.

info.text:
Jacko advertises his cloak-and-dagger services in seedy places throughout the Borderlands. For the right price, Jacko will trail, rob, rough up, or take out any mark—no questions asked.

Satisfied customers parrot his cheesy slogan: "Jacko always has your back-o."

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries.description: While in sunlight, the kuo-toa has Disadvantage [XPHB] on ability checks and attack rolls.

entries.name: Brine Slicer
entries.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

entries.name: Slippery
entries.description: The kuo-toa takes the Disengage [XPHB] action.

info.text:
Kuo-toa have slimy, humanoid bodies and the heads of goggle-eyed deep-sea fish. They claim they once dominated whole worlds, their empires spanning land and sea under the blessings of piscine gods.

Kuo-toa undertake contrived plots to propel themselves to dominance, often kidnapping people to learn their secrets or making dubious sacrifices to bizarre gods. These marauders lurk in wet places, eager to shed blood and claim plunder.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries.description: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The lizardfolk makes one Bite attack and one Bone Pike attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

entries.name: Bone Pike
entries.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Poison Spit
entries.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Poison damage.

info.text: Lizardfolk wardens draw on primal magic to protect nature's boundaries. These territorial guardians lurk in wetlands and jungles, surfacing from murky pools to track down trespassers and drive them out. Wardens wield weapons and shields fashioned from the husks of giant beetles, snapping turtles, and other mighty creatures. When these tools fail them, they channel the forces of nature to augment their natural attacks with poison saliva.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Narthus makes two attacks using Vile Mace or Fateful Bolt in any combination.

entries.name: Vile Mace
entries.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Fateful Bolt
entries.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 120 ft. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of Narthus's next turn has Advantage [XPHB].

info.text:
A craven lackey, Narthus serves Ivlis out of fear rather than loyalty. Narthus spends his days groveling before Ivlis and cruelly whipping new initiates to the Cult of Chaos into shape. Narthus's feral nature leads some cultists to speculate that he was raised by wild animals.

Ivlis prizes Narthus for his obsequity and morbid fascinations. He grows the cult's ranks through macabre rituals, conscripting the dead to serve the cult's depraved goals.

entries.name: Rapier
entries.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Light Crossbow
entries.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Parry
entries.description: Trigger: Pral is hit with a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: Pral adds 2 to his AC against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss.

info.text: Pral's boyishly handsome, self-assured grin graces wanted posters throughout the Borderlands. A self-proclaimed "gentleman thief," Pral abides by a strict personal code. He never kills, and he always upholds his end of any bargain he makes. A lover of good food, comfortable lodgings, and stylish clothing, Pral squanders the spoils of each robbery on his extravagant lifestyle.

entries.name: Needle Sword
entries.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Enchanting Bow
entries.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 40/160 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed [XPHB] condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

entries.name: Heart Sight
entries.description: CHA Saving Throw: 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, Undead automatically fail the save). Failure: The sprite knows the target's emotions.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries.description: The sprite has the Invisible [XPHB] condition for 1 minute. This effect ends early immediately after the sprite makes an attack roll or deals damage, or if the sprite has the Incapacitated [XPHB] condition.

info.text: Sprites are wee spirits of nature that can see the innate goodness or wickedness of other creatures. Those that enter their realms with good intentions might be treated with tiny feasts and celebrations. The wicked face nasty tricks and bold ambushes at the hands of invisible sprite defenders.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Vinx makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Sling in any combination.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

entries.name: Sling
entries.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

info.text:
This itinerant explorer knows the caves around the Keep on the Borderlands better than anyone else. Vinx frequently delves these caves in search of treasure.

Recently, Vinx got caught in a bind while pursuing a stolen family heirloom. When she gets loose, those goblins won't know what hit them!

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries.description: While in sunlight, the wight has Disadvantage [XPHB] on ability checks and attack rolls.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The wight makes two attacks, using Necrotic Sword or Necrotic Bow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Drink Life.

entries.name: Necrotic Sword
entries.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Necrotic Bow
entries.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Drink Life Recharge 5–6
entries.description: CON Saving Throw: 13, one creature within 5 feet. Failure: 6 (1d8 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the wight regains a number of Hit Points [XPHB] equal to the Necrotic damage taken.

info.text: Wights are the withered corpses of relentless warriors whose wickedness sustains them beyond death. After dying and returning from the grave, a wight continues its villainous ways, but it is now driven by a hunger for life. A wight drains living essence through its attacks.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries.description: The drake has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the drake's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Surprise Attack
entries.description: If the drake surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

info.source: Hoard of the Dragon Queen, page 88

entries.name: Special Equipment
entries.description: Azbara has two scrolls of mage armor.

entries.name: Potent Cantrips
entries.description: When Azbara casts an evocation Cantrips and misses, or the target succeeds on its saving throw, the target still takes half the cantrip's damage but suffers no other effect.

entries.name: Sculpt Spells
entries.description: When Azbara casts an evocation spell that affects other creatures that he can see, he can choose a number of them equal to 1+the spell's level to succeed on their saving throws against the spell. Those creatures take no damage if they would normally take half damage from the spell.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Azbara is a 6th-level spellcaster that uses Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). Azbara has the following spells prepared from the wizard spell list:

Spellcasting ability: INT.

Cantrips (at will): mage hand, prestidigitation, ray of frost, shocking grasp

Level 1 (4 slots): fog cloud, magic missile, shield, thunderwave

Level 2 (3 slots): invisibility, misty step, scorching ray

Level 3 (3 slots): counterspell, dispel magic, fireball

3/day each: fog cloud, levitate

entries.description: Dralmorrer has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

entries.name: War Magic

entries.name: Weapon Bond
entries.description: Provided his longsword is on the same plane Dralmorrer can take a bonus action to teleport it to his hand.

entries.description: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The troll attacks five times, once with its bite and four times with its claws. If two or more claws hit the same target, the troll rends the target, dealing an extra 2d6 slashing damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

info.text: Sometimes when a troll loses a limb, it regenerates two limbs to replace the one it lost. This can result in trolls with multiple arms. A four-armed troll uses the troll stat block, except that it is a Challenge Rating 6 monster (2,300 XP) and has alternate action options to suit.
info.source: Hoard of the Dragon Queen, page 65

entries.description: Frulam attacks twice with her halberd.

entries.name: 5etools Note
entries.description: Leosin Erlanthar is presented in Hoard of the Dragon Queen [HotDQ] as a half-elf monk. The martial arts adept [vgm] stat block from Volo's Guide to Monsters [VGM] has been provided here for ease of use.

entries.name: Unarmored Defense
entries.description: While the adept is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The adept makes three unarmed strikes or three dart attacks.

entries.name: Unarmed Strike
entries.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, the adept can choose one of the following additional effects:

• The target must succeed on a 13 Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding (adept's choice).
• The target must succeed on a 13 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
• The target must succeed on a 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the adept's next turn.

entries.name: Dart
entries.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Deflect Missile
entries.description: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, the adept deflects the missile. The damage it takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 3. If the damage is reduced to 0, the adept catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and the adept has a hand free.

info.source: Hoard of the Dragon Queen, page 87

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

Level 1 (4 slots): divine favor, guiding bolt, healing word, shield of faith

Level 2 (3 slots): lesser restoration, magic weapon, prayer of healing, silence, spiritual weapon

Level 3 (3 slots): beacon of hope, crusader's mantle, dispel magic, revivify, spirit guardians, water walk

Level 4 (3 slots): banishment, freedom of movement, guardian of faith, stoneskin

Level 5 (1 slots): flame strike, mass cure wounds, hold monster

entries.name: Multiattack

entries.name: Maul
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

info.text:
Ideals: Responsibility, greater good ("The strong must defend the weak, whatever the cost.")

Personality Traits: Friendly, hot-tempered

Pledged Resources: Paladins and healing clerics to support the fight against Tiamat's forces
info.source: Hoard of the Dragon Queen, page 28

entries.name: Special Equipment
entries.description: Rezmir has the Black Dragon Mask [hotdq], Hazirawn [hotdq], and an insignia of claws [hotdq].

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Rezmir can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Dark Advantage
entries.description: Once per turn, Rezmir can deal an extra 10 (3d6) damage when she hits with a weapon attack, provided Rezmir has advantage on the attack roll.

entries.description: While wearing no armor and wearing the Black Dragon Mask, Rezmir adds her Charisma bonus to her AC (included).

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries.description: If Rezmir fails a saving throw while wearing the Black Dragon Mask, she can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Greatsword (Hazirawn)
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points for 1 minute. The target can make a 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect early on a success.

entries.name: Caustic Bolt
entries.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) acid damage.

entries.name: Acid Breath Recharge 5–6
entries.description: Rezmir breathes acid in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

sections.title: Legendary Actions
sections.description: If she is wearing the Black Dragon Mask, Rezmir can take up to two legendary actions between each of her turns, taking the actions all at once or spreading them over the round. A legendary action can be taken only at the start or end of a turn.

entries.name: Darkness (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: A 15-foot radius of magical darkness extends from a point Rezmir can see within 60 feet of her and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts as long as Rezmir maintains concentration, up to 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and no natural light can illuminate it. If any of the area overlaps with a area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell creating the light is dispelled.

entries.name: Melee Attack
entries.description: Rezmir makes one melee attack.

entries.name: Hide
entries.description: Rezmir takes the Hide action.

info.source: Hoard of the Dragon Queen, page 93

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries.description:
If Sandesyl isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, Sandesyl can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, Sandesyl can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: If Sandesyl fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Misty Escape
entries.description:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, Sandesyl transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Sandesyl regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Sandesyl takes radiant damage or damage from holy water [PHB], this trait doesn't function at the start of Sandesyl's next turn.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.description: Sandesyl can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries.description:
Sandesyl has the following flaws:

• Forbiddance.

Sandesyl can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.
• Harmed by Running Water.

Sandesyl takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.
• Stake to the Heart.

If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Sandesyl's heart while Sandesyl is incapacitated in its resting place, Sandesyl is paralyzed until the stake is removed.
• Sunlight Hypersensitivity.

Sandesyl takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

entries.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries.description: Sandesyl makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

entries.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Sandesyl can grapple the target (escape 18).

entries.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by Sandesyl, incapacitated, or restrained. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Sandesyl regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Sandesyl's control.

entries.name: Charm
entries.description:
Sandesyl targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see Sandesyl, the target must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by Sandesyl. The charmed target regards Sandesyl as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Sandesyl's control, it takes Sandesyl's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for Sandesyl's bite attack.

Each time Sandesyl or Sandesyl's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Sandesyl is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

entries.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
entries.description: Sandesyl magically calls 2d4 swarms of bats or rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, Sandesyl can call 3d6 wolves instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of Sandesyl and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Sandesyl dies, or until Sandesyl dismisses them as a bonus action.

entries.name: Move
entries.description: Sandesyl moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Unarmed Strike
entries.description: Sandesyl makes one unarmed strike.

entries.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Sandesyl makes one bite attack.

info.source: Hoard of the Dragon Queen, page 81

entries.name: Special Equipment
entries.description: Talis has +1 scale mail and a wand of winter [hotdq].

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries.description: Talis has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

entries.name: Winter Strike (3/Day)
entries.description: Once per turn, when Talis hits with a melee attack, she can expend a use of this trait to deal an extra 9 (2d8) cold damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Talis is a 9th-level spellcaster that uses Wisdom as her spellcasting ability (spell save 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Talis has the following spells prepared from the cleric spell list:

Spellcasting ability: WIS.

Cantrips (at will): guidance, resistance, thaumaturgy

Level 1 (4 slots): command, cure wounds, healing word, inflict wounds

Level 2 (3 slots): blindness/deafness, lesser restoration, spiritual weapon (spear)

Level 3 (3 slots): dispel magic, mass healing word, sending

Level 4 (3 slots): death ward, freedom of movement

Level 5 (1 slots): insect plague

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or ranged 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

info.source: Hoard of the Dragon Queen, page 93

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries.description: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The troll attacks five times, once with its bite and four times with its claws. If two or more claws hit the same target, the troll rends the target, dealing an extra 2d6 slashing damage.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

info.text: Sometimes when a troll loses a limb, it regenerates two limbs to replace the one it lost. This can result in trolls with multiple arms. A four-armed troll uses the troll stat block, except that it is a Challenge Rating 6 monster (2,300 XP) and has alternate action options to suit.
info.source: Hoard of the Dragon Queen, page 63

entries.name: Mountain Born
entries.description: Aruk is acclimated to high altitude, including elevations above 20,000 feet.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries.description: Aruk counts as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity and the weight it can push, drag, or lift.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Aruk makes two attacks with its greataxe or hurls two javelins.

entries.name: Greataxe
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage.

entries.name: Javelin
entries.description: Melee Weapon or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Stone's Endurance (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries.description: When Aruk takes damage, it reduces the damage taken by 9 (1d12 + 3).

info.text: Goliaths inhabit the Spine of the World, where their mettle is tested against orcs, ogres, frost giants, remorhazes, ice trolls, young white dragons, the treacherous mountain terrain, and the cruel indifference of nature.
info.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, page 169

entries.name: Ice Walk
entries.description: Arveiaturace can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: If Arveiaturace fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Arveiaturace can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.

entries.name: Tail
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Frightful Presence
entries.description: Each creature of Arveiaturace's choice that is within 120 feet of Arveiaturace and aware of it must succeed on a 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Arveiaturace's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Cold Breath Recharge 5–6
entries.description: Arveiaturace exhales an icy blast in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 72 (16d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Detect
entries.description: Arveiaturace makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

entries.name: Tail Attack
entries.description: Arveiaturace makes a tail attack.

entries.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Arveiaturace beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of Arveiaturace must succeed on a 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Arveiaturace can then fly up to half its flying speed.

info.text:
Known to Ten-Towners as the White Wyrm, Arveiaturace is an ancient white dragon that lairs atop the Reghed Glacier. She remains the most fearsome predator in Icewind Dale, although age has clouded her eyes with cataracts, limiting the range of her vision to 60 feet. Her blindsight, hearing, and sense of smell are undiminished, however. Fortunately for the residents of the dale, she prefers the taste of reindeer, walrus, and polar bear flesh to that of humanoids. The dragon has a healthy respect for humanoids and has never threatened Ten-Towns directly, though it wouldn't take much to provoke her into doing so.

At one time, Arveiaturace served a wizard named Meltharond, whose frozen corpse remains strapped to a saddle on the dragon's back. Arveiaturace has never acknowledged his death and still speaks to his body as if he were alive. He was, while he lived, her only friend and confidant.
info.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, page 105

images.title: Arveiaturace the White Wyrm and Her Mysterious Rider

entries.name: Divine Being
entries.description: Auril can't be surprised and can't be changed into another form against her will.

entries.name: Divine Rejuvenation
entries.description: When Auril drops to 0 hit points, her body turns to slush and melts away. Auril instantly reappears in her second form [IDRotF], in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of where her first form disappeared. Her initiative count doesn't change.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day in This Form)
entries.description: If Auril fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Auril has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Unusual Nature
entries.description: Auril doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Auril's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

Spellcasting ability: CHA.

At will: chromatic orb (cold orb only; see "Actions" below), detect magic, misty step

2/day each: control weather, detect thoughts, ice storm

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Auril attacks twice with her talons.

entries.name: Talons
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

entries.name: Touch of Frost
entries.description: Melee Spell Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d8) cold damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Chromatic Orb
entries.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +13 to hit, range 90 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d8) cold damage.

entries.name: Talons
entries.description: Auril attacks once with her talons.

entries.name: Teleport
entries.description: Auril teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet of her.

entries.name: Touch of Frost (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Auril uses Touch of Frost.

info.text:
In her first form, Auril appears as a hunched, 7-foot-tall biped with the head of a snowy owl, black talons, cloven hooves, and grayish-white wolf fur covering her body from the neck down. Protruding from her feathery owl's head is a pair of curved goat horns. A cloak and cowl made of pristine white snow conceals much of her tripartite form, which her worshipers refer to as the Cold Crone. This cloak can transform into a pair of owl's wings when Auril sees fit.

Auril the Frostmaiden.

Auril the Frostmaiden is a neutral evil lesser god of cold indifference who embodies winter's cruelty. (For information on what defines a lesser god, see the "Divine Rank [DMG]" sidebar in the Dungeon Master's Guide [DMG].) Auril's beloved ice grasps all things in her clutches, preserving them against the ravages of time. She hoards beauty in all forms, from art objects and flowers to skilled artisans and their wondrous works, freezing them in magical ice for her pleasure alone.

Auril was aligned with the gods Talos, Umberlee, and Malar. Together they wrought terrible destruction, inspiring fear that compelled tribute to hold their power at bay. Umberlee, queen of the wrathful sea, grew to despise the enduring nature of the ice and snow Auril created. Umberlee seethed when Auril's frigid cold transformed her chaotic, unpredictable tides into rigid, motionless sheets of ice. Umberlee brought Talos and Malar into an alliance against Auril, who retreated to the coldest corner of Toril to escape their fury.

After a world-shaking event known as the Sundering, most of the gods withdrew from Toril, leaving mortals to govern their own fates without the gods' meddling, but the Frostmaiden could not stay away for long. Auril returned to her icy realm in the far north and, after a time, plunged it into frigid darkness using her magic.

Casting such great magic night after night while also granting spells to her devoted followers leaves Auril weak and vulnerable. In her self-inflicted weakened state, Auril is inclined to be cautious and avoid contact with other creatures that can harm her.

Auril's worshipers know better than to disturb her self-imposed isolation. Terrible blizzards have cut off Icewind Dale from the rest of the world, and a shroud of mist conceals her island in the Sea of Moving Ice.

Roleplaying Auril.

Portraying a deity, even a lesser god such as Auril the Frostmaiden, can be daunting. For roleplaying purposes, the following suggestions might prove helpful:

• So long as she has mortal worshipers, Auril can't truly die (although the characters can rid the world of her for a time). Thus, she has no reason to capitulate to mortals' demands. As the embodiment of winter's cruelty, she is incapable of showing mercy or compassion. Play her as a supremely cold and unfeeling entity.
• Have Auril speak only when necessary. The less she talks, the less risk you have of unintentionally demystifying her in the eyes of your players. Let her actions, not her words, define her.
• Lesser gods in the D&D multiverse are extremely powerful and arrogant, but also fallible and blind to their own flaws. It's appropriate for Auril to act as though she's invincible while underestimating her mortal enemies, even in her current weakened state.

Lair Actions.

Auril dwells on Solstice, a frozen island hidden among the titanic icebergs in the Sea of Moving Ice. Few creatures know of this island, let alone how to reach it. See chapter 5 [IDRotF] for information about the regional effects [IDRotF] that encompass the island.

While she's on the island, the Frostmaiden can take one of the following lair actions on initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties):

• Auril instantly knows the locations and health of all other creatures on the island. She knows how much damage each of these creatures has taken, how many levels of exhaustion they have, and what conditions are affecting them currently.
• Auril instantly teleports to any location on the island. If the space she chooses as her destination is already occupied, Auril appears in the closest unoccupied space to it instead.
• Auril telepathically communicates with any number of creatures at once, provided they're all on the island. This effect lasts until Auril stops concentrating on it (as if concentrating on a spell) or until she leaves the island or uses a different lair action.

Auril's Three Forms.

In her current weakened state, Auril can assume three different forms. To destroy her, heroes must reduce each of her forms to 0 hit points one after another. After she's defeated in her third and final form, Auril dies. As long as she has mortal followers who worship her, however, Auril is reborn at full strength during the next winter solstice, with divine power far beyond what is reflected in the stat blocks presented here.

After finishing a long rest, Auril regains any of her forms that were destroyed, provided at least one form survives. When she transitions from one form to another, she loses all the traits and actions of the old form and gains those of the new form.

A stat block is given for each of Auril's three forms. These descriptions do not reflect Auril at full power, but rather Auril as she is encountered in this adventure.
info.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, page 275

entries.description: Auril can't be surprised and can't be changed into another form against her will.

entries.description: When Auril drops to 0 hit points, her body collapses into shards of ice, whereupon Auril instantly reappears in her third form [IDRotF], in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of where her second form was destroyed. Her initiative count doesn't change.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day in This Form)
entries.description: If Auril fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Auril has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Unusual Nature
entries.description: Auril doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Auril attacks twice with her ice morningstar or hurls three ice darts.

entries.name: Ice Morningstar
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

entries.name: Ice Dart
entries.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

entries.name: Cone of Cold (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries.description: Auril causes a magical blast of cold air to erupt from her hand. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Create Ice Mephit (3/Day)
entries.description: Auril breaks off an icicle from her body and hurls it into an unoccupied space she can see within 20 feet of her, where it magically transforms into an ice mephit (see its entry in the Monster Manual). The mephit acts immediately after Auril in the initiative order and obeys her commands.

entries.name: Ice Stasis Recharge 5–6
entries.description: Auril magically creates a gem-sized ice crystal that hovers in a space within 5 feet of her. Auril then targets a creature she can see within 60 feet of the crystal. The target must succeed on a 21 Charisma saving throw or become trapped in the crystal, which is immovable. If the saving throw succeeds, the crystal shatters and nothing else happens. A creature trapped in the crystal is stunned, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the crystal, and takes 21 (6d6) cold damage at the start of each of its turns. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, freeing itself on a success. The creature is also freed if the crystal is destroyed, which is a Tiny object with AC 18, 9 hit points, and immunity to all damage except fire damage. The freed creature appears in an unoccupied space of its choice within 30 feet of the shattered crystal.

entries.name: Attack
entries.description: Auril makes one weapon attack.

entries.name: Ice Flurry (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Each creature within 30 feet of Auril takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage from swirling ice, and nonmagical, open flames in that area are extinguished.

entries.name: Splinter (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.description: Auril uses Create Ice Mephit or causes one to ice mephit she can see within 60 feet of her to explode and die. A mephit that dies in this way does not use its Death Burst. Instead, each creature within 10 feet of the exploding mephit must succeed on a 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) piercing damage on a failed saving throw, and half as much damage on a successful one.

info.text:
Auril's second form, known to her worshipers as Lady Icekiss or the Brittle Maiden, is that of a 10-foot-tall woman of fearsome aspect made entirely of ice and frost. Her eyes burn with a cold blue light, and a thin cloak of mist forms around her. Blades of ice grow out of her body at odd angles, breaking off before they get too long. When she moves, her body crackles.

In this form, Auril creates weapons of ice with which to combat foes. These weapons are supernaturally resilient until Auril discards them, whereupon they break and melt like normal ice.

entries.name: Frigid Aura
